abilities.title: Damage by ability
abilities.description: Per preset and ability (pets included): DPS, share of damage, casts, hits, crits, ticks, average hit and crit, misses, dodges and glances per fight.

auras.title: Buff and debuff uptime
auras.description: Per preset, the average share of the fight each aura is up on the player or the boss, and how often it is applied.

builds.title: Presets and headline DPS
builds.description: One row per level 60 preset: mean DPS over 20,000 simulated 180 s fights against the generic boss, percentiles, best race overall and per faction, and talents. Encounter presets (the boss as one creature type) are extra rows with their creature type. Simmed on master baed22e62's class code plus warrior 38b94b40a; most builds ran before per-hit rounding (about 0.007%), see provenance.json.

gear.title: Gear
gear.description: Per preset, the item and enchant in each slot of its synthetic Phase 1 set.

hist.title: Fight-to-fight spread
hist.description: Per preset, how many of the 20,000 fights landed in each 5 DPS bin.

icons.title: Talent and spell icons
icons.description: 36 px class, race, faction and preset icons, and 56 px header icons, as data URLs. The Ranking tab needs only these, so they load first.

icons_more.title: More icons
icons_more.description: 36 px spell, item and aura icons and the sim UI's empty gear-slot icons, as data URLs. They load after the Ranking tab is up.

lengths.title: DPS by fight length
lengths.description: Every preset at 60, 120, 180, 300 and 480 s average fight length, 5,000 fights each.

mana.title: Mana over a long fight
mana.description: Per mana-using preset, its mana as a % of max every 5 s through a 480 s fight with its own consumes and rotation: the average over 100 fights (pct) and the 25th and 75th percentile fight (p25, p75).

mana_summary.title: When mana runs low
mana_summary.description: Per mana-using preset over the same 480 s fights: when mana first drops below 15% of max (median and 25th to 75th percentile fight, empty when most fights never do), the share of fights that ever do, mana % at 60, 180, 300 and 480 s, mana spent and gained per second, and the sim's seconds out of mana, time to OOM and mana left at the end over 5,000 fights.

names.title: Spell and item names
names.description: Names, icons and an icon-derived colour for the spell, item and attack ids in the timelines, breakdowns and rotations.

notes.title: Talents, rotation and caveats
notes.description: Per preset, its key talents, rotation priority, consumes and open questions, plus the gear rules every synthetic set follows (build _round, kind gear).

race_breakdown.title: Race DPS split by racial
race_breakdown.description: Each preset and race split into base stats (every racial off) and what each racial adds, plus the weapon swap and the change against each creature type. Racials turned off one at a time; where two count, each gets the average of its two orders so the parts add up.

race_notes.title: Race scenario notes
race_notes.description: What each race scenario switches on, what each racial does in the sim, and a few plain sentences per class written from the race sims.

race_summary.title: Race usefulness
race_summary.description: Per scenario, role and race, across all races or within the race's faction: presets it can play, how often it is the best race, its average and worst gap to the best, its median rank and the presets where it comes closest.

race_variants.title: Race scenarios
race_variants.description: Every preset on every race its class can be: against the generic boss with the preset's own setup, against a Beast or an Elemental boss, against a Humanoid boss (Priests only, for Dwarf Chastise), with the race's racial weapon, and with all racials off. Mean DPS over 10,000 fights at 180 s, its standard error, and the gap to the best race in that scenario.

races.title: Race sweep
races.description: Every preset on every race its class can be: mean DPS over 10,000 fights at 180 s, and the gap to the best race.

rotation.title: Rotation priority lists
rotation.description: Each preset's APL as simmed: pre-pull casts with their timing, then the priority list in order, each line's spell, a plain-English condition, the APL's own note, its exact condition and the spell's casts per fight.

setup.title: Consumes and raid buffs
setup.description: Per preset, the consumes, self buffs, raid and party buffs, boss debuffs and professions in its sim settings, grouped as the sim UI groups them. active says whether the entry changes the preset's result in the sim (each entry left out in turn, same seed: an identical DPS means no effect); why gives the reason when it doesn't, such as a non-stacking pair, a buff the class already provides, or something WoW Forever doesn't have.

stats.title: Character sheets
stats.description: Per preset, final character stats with gear, talents, buffs and consumes.

talenttrees.title: Talent trees
talenttrees.description: Every class talent tree as the sim UI lays it out: each talent’s row, column, ranks, prerequisite, text from ui/core/talents/trees, and the wowhead page of each rank (Forever's database where it has the spell, else Classic's).

timeline_druid.title: Druid sample fights
timeline_druid.description: Three single fights per druid preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_hunter.title: Hunter sample fights
timeline_hunter.description: Three single fights per hunter preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_mage.title: Mage sample fights
timeline_mage.description: Three single fights per mage preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_paladin.title: Paladin sample fights
timeline_paladin.description: Three single fights per paladin preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_priest.title: Priest sample fights
timeline_priest.description: Three single fights per priest preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_rogue.title: Rogue sample fights
timeline_rogue.description: Three single fights per rogue preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_shaman.title: Shaman sample fights
timeline_shaman.description: Three single fights per shaman preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_warlock.title: Warlock sample fights
timeline_warlock.description: Three single fights per warlock preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

timeline_warrior.title: Warrior sample fights
timeline_warrior.description: Three single fights per warrior preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): every cast, damage event, aura and resource change.

tooltips.title: Game tooltip text
tooltips.description: Tooltip text for the spells, items, enchants, consumes, races and stat weights on the page: wowhead's WoW Forever database first (with a link to its page), the Forever client's talent text and the Forever wiki where it has nothing, Classic's text only as a marked last resort, the sim's own numbers where they differ, the item database for the synthetic gear, and the Forever racials.

treeart.title: Talent tree art
treeart.description: Each class talent tree’s icon and background art (the backgrounds the sim UI uses, from Wowhead), stored as data URLs.

weights.title: Stat weights
weights.description: Per preset, the DPS one more point of each stat adds (per 1% for hit and crit), measured by adding the stat on top of the gear and simming 40,000 fights at 180 s with the baseline’s seed; worth is in points of the preset’s main stat.
